message.content: Starting with broad random sweeps, then chasing rare edge cases.
Random probing found a track violation — now I'll isolate the minimal failing case.
Shrunk to a push-free drift case. Replaying to confirm it's deterministic.
Replay confirmed — now inspecting the violation and the lead-up.
Violation at step 206 — checking the trajectory leading into it.
Cart drifts off unaided — inspecting the start and mid-run to explain why.
I see a slow uncontrolled drift. Testing whether centering the start removes the failure.
Centered start passes — gathering one more trajectory point to ground the report.
